chunks.text: Drizzling or Light rainfall is expected in the western zone for the forth coming week. 15th & 16th September may get 15-20mm of rainfall in all three districts. Isolated places along the Western Ghats may receive thunderstorm. Hence, avoid trespassing and animal grazing near Western Ghats. Irrigation may be continued based on the soil moisture. Provide adequate draining to young crops.

Due to prevailing weather, Thrips insect attack is observed in Samba paddy nursery. Spray Azadirachtin 0.15% @ 2ml per lit of water. Also watch for diseases. In the absence of wet nursery and if sufficient ground water is available, direct dry seeding of medium duration rice can be done with the anticipated rain for Samba season.
By utilizing the anticipated rainfall, land preparation may be initiated in rainfed black soil towards pre monsoon sowing.
With the receipt of anticipated rainfall dry lands may be prepared for sowing groundnut and millets during North East Monsoon.
Prevailing wind speed is more than 10 km per hour along with light rainfall. Hence, five months old sugarcane may be propped against lodging.
Prevailing weather is favourable for sucking pests and leaf minor in tomato. Spray 3% neem Seed Kernel Extract to control the pests.
Prevailing wind speed is more than 10 km per hour along with light rainfall. Hence, five months old banana may be propped against lodging.

Turmeric is at bulking stage, which is critical for both moisture stress and excess water. Hence, care to keep sufficient moisture and avoid excess moisture or over dry. Prevailing high relative humidity and wind speed would spread the spores of turmeric leaf spot from endemic area. Spray Mancozeb @ 1 kg/ha or copper oxy chloride @ 1.25 kg/ha.

Present high wind speed and relative humidity may force the animals to take more drinking water. Provide enough clean drinking water to the animals. Due to the prevailing wind speed, feeds of the poultry chicken gets wasted to avoid plant based oils may be mixed feeds of the poultry.
